title: Part Fourteen: Dragged In: the American Bill

sections.brief: The US–Iran ledger 1979–2026 not covered in hz12/ow7: the hostage crisis and Desert One; the 1987–88 tanker war (Earnest Will, USS Stark (Iraqi), Samuel B. Roberts, Praying Mantis, two Marine aviators); Iran Air 655 (290 killed, 1996 ex gratia payment); the Pentagon's 603 Iraq figure with its caveats; Soleimani and Ain al-Asad (warning, 109 TBI); then brief links to Tower 22, the defence of Israel, Midnight Hammer and the 2026 war ($43.6bn, 21 dead) and new EIA/AAA energy-price data. Figures: money ledger; time

Who pushed and who decided: dated Israeli advocacy (Olmert 2008, Pardo's 2011 countdown, 2012 red line, 2013 request, 2015 Congress, 2018 archive, the February 2026 call; Netanyahu's denial; Trump's 'forced Israel's hand'; Rubio's 'Israeli action'); AIPAC's 2015 and 2026 positions and spending (disclosure is not causation); US advocates (Graham, Levin, FDD) and opponents (Kent's resignation and the responses to it, Gabbard's record and her non-Iran resignation, Greene, Massie, Democrats, Cato); Congress 2020 and March 2026 votes (link hz12_wars); polling 2025–26; closing assessment of 'dragged in' episode by episode. Figures: time; compare
